levels.surface: عبادة بن الوليد بن عبادة بن الصامت

notes: Four co-transmitters of Ibn Idris stand in one level (rule 2)
«عن أبيه» with no name is a relation link (rule 7); the last link is the Companion Ubada, whose words («قال بايعنا») carry the saying
The name «عبادة بن الصامت» stands twice in the text; the second is the Companion
